release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 97. Adds a Web UI button under OLED screen controls to start a complete four-hour trend and 48-hour treatment backfill. The backfill uses the existing low-priority background worker, retains live-glucose priority, checks Nightscout and Wi-Fi availability, and prevents duplicate backfill requests. Moves cloud queue, cloud send, alarm episode, last cloud send, loop timing, task state, FIFO state, trend progress, treatment progress and queue-drop diagnostics into Advanced view. Retains the persistent Web UI local-buzzer master checkbox, physical buzzer controls, pre-TLS response allocation, fully released TLS retry, bounded Nightscout history requests, serialized secure connections, persistent three-profile Wi-Fi storage, full NVS factory reset, verified OTA finalization, Nightscout SAGE, IOB and COB support, daily treatment history and caregiver WhatsApp routing.
